message: Fixed. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100, so refunds came out 100 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`. `npm test` passes, including the partial-refund tests.
